snippet.title: Dumb Ways To Party - World Premiere Reveal | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: A new multiplayer party game for up to 4 players! Find out who will win the prize title of "Dumbest of The Dumb!" by competing in a series of whacky challenges! Dumb Ways To Party is coming to Steam, Nintendo Switch 1 and 2, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4 and Xbox in 2026.
